identity.name: Matcha × Simple Trash Slot Visual Compatibility

goals: Keep Simple Trash Slot visually native to the Matcha Flavoured inventory while preserving its existing trash behavior.
Preserve the accepted inventory-layout boundary by using Simple Trash Slot's built-in placement instead of introducing a second rendering or logical-slot implementation.
scope: Retain the frozen H2 visual contract: frame origin (151,61), click/slot origin (152,62), and normal upstream rendering and interaction.
Retain the user's completion declaration for the approved visual/resource-pack scope without inferring unreported per-case runtime results.
Keep the project artifact-free unless a newly demonstrated visual defect proves that the upstream configuration is insufficient.

exclusions: Coordinate mixins, duplicate visual-positioning layers, broad GUI replacements, or new compatibility implementation during this migration.
Changes to the trash slot's menu or backing index, deletion semantics, Inventory Extended size, Trinkets boundaries, quick-move destinations, offhand boundaries, or other inventory behavior.
Modification or redistribution of Matcha Flavoured, Simple Trash Slot, Inventory Extended, Trinkets, their pristine binaries, or anything under originals/.
Minecraft launch, deployment, Test Slot mutation, accepted-baseline changes, promotion, Test Instance Manager changes, and protected gameplay-instance access.
Legacy README status/planning systems, global status databases, historical test matrices, snapshots, deployment history, and unrelated project artifacts.

dependencies.reason: Target game version of the frozen inventory-layout and visual contract.

Current-main authority for the accepted inventory layout and final GUI coordinates; it preserves Simple Trash Slot's logical compatibility while leaving screen placement to the upstream configuration.
Exact active Matcha base-pack identity recorded by the frozen visual evidence; newer Matcha identities are not silently substituted by this migration.
Owns the built-in H2 placement, visible Trash rendering, click target, and deletion behavior preserved by this project.
Exact frozen accepted six-row inventory/layout dependency whose rows, mapping, and logical storage boundary must remain unchanged.
Optional frozen accepted inventory-layout participant, using the canonical current-main mod identity, whose slot groups must not overlap the configured Trash placement.
Canonical frozen accepted coordinate boundary consumed when Trinkets is present; this project must not replace it with another slot-layout model.
Exact adjacent Matcha inventory artwork identity recorded for the accepted layout; it remains external and is not a project artifact.

state.milestone: The user-confirmed visual/resource-pack scope remains complete through Simple Trash Slot's built-in H2 placement at frame (151,61) and click/slot (152,62); no project artifact or additional runtime result exists.
